::: {.team-body}
### Doug Leasure, PhD

::: {.team-role}
Executive Director & Research Data Scientist
:::

::: {.team-bio}
Founding Director of Real Good Research. Develops population nowcasting methods to support humanitarian response, sustainable development, and conservation. Previously at [Oxford’s Leverhulme Centre for Demographic Science](https://demography.ox.ac.uk){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, [WorldPop](https://worldpop.org){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, and the [River Basin Center](https://rivercenter.uga.org){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}.
:::
:::
:::


<!-- Claire --->

::: {.team-card}
![](assets/images/about/claire.jpg){fig-alt="Claire Dooley"}

::: {.team-body}
### Claire Dooley, DPhil

::: {.team-role}
Director & Applied Researcher in Survey Methods and Spatial Analysis
:::
::: {.team-bio}
Lecturer in Spatial Data Science at [UCL’s Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/casa){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}. Uses survey methods and spatial analysis to understand the needs of marginalised populations.
:::
:::
:::


<!-- Edith --->

::: {.team-card}
![](assets/images/about/edith.png){fig-alt="Edith Darin"}

::: {.team-body}
### Edith Darin, DPhil

::: {.team-role}
Director & Population Data Scientist
:::
::: {.team-bio}
Researcher at [Oxford’s Leverhulme Centre for Demographic Science](https://demography.ox.ac.uk){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}. Develops statistical methods to estimate forced displacement and fill gaps in population censuses.
:::
:::
:::

### Prof. Seth Wenger

::: {.team-role}
Director & Applied Freshwater Ecologist
:::
::: {.team-bio}
Professor at [UGA’s Odum School of Ecology](https://ecology.uga.edu/){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"} and Director of Science at its [River Basin Center](https://rivercenter.uga.edu){.bold-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}.
